name: Easydict
title: Easydict: free DeepL alternative for Mac
caption:
DeepL Pro charges €7.49/month to translate text. Easydict does it for free on your Mac 🌍

✅ Select text, press a shortcut, get the translation instantly
✅ Screenshot anything on screen and translate the text in it
✅ Compares Google, Bing, DeepL and Apple Translate side by side
✅ Auto-detects the language, 52 languages to pick from

💻 Mac (macOS 13+)
ℹ️ Google, Bing, DeepL and Apple Translate work out of the box with no API key, but AI services like OpenAI, Gemini and Claude need your own API key. DeepL's €7.49/month is the Individual plan billed yearly, and the web-style DeepL inside Easydict isn't the same as a paid Pro account

Comment "TRANSLATE" and I'll DM you the link 🔗

Follow @itsongit for a new free open-source find every day

beats.say: You might be paying ninety euros a year for something your Mac can do for free.
DeepL Pro costs seven forty nine a month. Easydict costs nothing.
Select any text, hit one shortcut, and the translation pops up right there.
Screenshot anything on your screen, and it translates the text inside.
It puts Google, DeepL and Apple Translate side by side.
It's DeepL Pro, minus the subscription, forever.
Comment Translate, and I'll send you the link.
